hypotheses.P1_powerlaw_bulk_replicates: All three full-width tensor spectra have bulk log-log R-squared at least 0.90.
hypotheses.P2_nulls_retain_bulk: At every layer both null families have median bulk R-squared at least 0.90 and exponent within 0.15 of observed.
hypotheses.P3_late_has_four_strict_spikes: All four final-layer leading singular values lie above the frozen power-law extrapolation.
hypotheses.P4_late_exceeds_coordination_nulls: The final layer's mean top-four log excess exceeds every sign and pairing null replicate.
hypotheses.P5_late_is_more_concentrated: Final-layer raw top-four energy exceeds both early and middle layers by at least 0.005.
hypotheses.P6_middle_lacks_strict_spikes: The middle layer has no positive top-four log excess under the frozen fit.
hypotheses.P7_depth_excess_pattern_replicates: Final-layer mean top-four log excess exceeds both early and middle layers by at least 0.10.
